mainEntity.name: What does Azure OpenAI actually cost in production?

acceptedAnswer.text: Azure OpenAI token prices depend on the model tier. Per 1 million tokens (Global Standard, October 2026), GPT-6 Luna costs $0.10 input / $0.50 output, GPT-6 Sol $2 / $10, and GPT-6 Astra $10 / $50. Production deployments cost far more than Microsoft's calculator shows. The calculator omits fine-tuning hosting fees ($1.70/hour, about $1,241/month per deployed model, charged regardless of usage), infrastructure requirements (Cognitive Services resources, Key Vault, and monitoring adding $35-50/month), and output tokens that cost 4-6× more than input tokens. A $10/month calculator estimate becomes about $1,288/month once a fine-tuned model is deployed to production.

mainEntity.name: Why is Microsoft's Azure OpenAI pricing calculator always wrong?

acceptedAnswer.text: Microsoft's Azure Pricing Calculator shows token costs only and assumes: pay-as-you-go token pricing with no fine-tuning, zero infrastructure costs beyond the API, equal input/output token ratios (actual: output tokens cost 4-6× more than input on current models), and no hosting fees, monitoring, or supporting services. These assumptions never match production deployments. A typical gap: the calculator shows $10/month, the actual bill is about $1,288/month, roughly 129 times the estimate.

mainEntity.name: What are the hidden costs of Azure OpenAI in production?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hidden Azure OpenAI costs include: fine-tuned model hosting at $1.70/hour, about $1,241/month per deployed model (charged even if unused), infrastructure overhead of $35/month minimum (Cognitive Services, Key Vault, monitoring), output tokens that cost 4-6× more than input tokens, cache-write charges on GPT-6 models (for example $2.50 per 1 million tokens on GPT-6 Sol), retry and error overhead (10-15% additional usage), and supporting services (Virtual Network with private endpoints at $7.20/month, Storage Account for logs at $2-5/month, Azure Monitor at $5-50/month depending on volume). With one fine-tuned model deployed, hidden costs typically add about $1,280/month to calculator estimates.

mainEntity.name: How much does GPT-6 cost compared to GPT-5 and GPT-4.1 in Azure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per 1 million tokens (Global Standard, October 2026): GPT-6 Astra costs $10 input / $50 output, GPT-6 Sol $2 / $10, and GPT-6 Luna $0.10 / $0.50. GPT-5.6 Terra costs $2 / $12 and GPT-5.6 Luna $0.20 / $1.20. GPT-4.1, now a legacy model, costs $2 / $8. GPT-6 Astra costs 5× as much as GPT-6 Sol per token, and GPT-6 Sol costs 20× as much as GPT-6 Luna, so routing simple workloads to the cheapest tier that handles them well is the largest single cost lever. Data Zone and Regional deployments cost about 10% more than Global.

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of fine-tuning Azure OpenAI models?

acceptedAnswer.text: Azure OpenAI fine-tuning costs include: training costs based on tokens in your training file (varies by model), hosting fees of $1.70/hour (about $1,241/month) per deployed fine-tuned model (charged continuously regardless of usage), and inference costs per 1 million tokens (separate charges for input and output usage). The hosting hours cost is critical: after a fine-tuned model is deployed, it continues to incur hourly costs even if not actively used. A deployed but inactive fine-tuned model costs about $1,241/month with zero API calls.

mainEntity.name: How can I reduce Azure OpenAI costs by 60%?

acceptedAnswer.text: Five proven strategies to reduce Azure OpenAI costs: 1) Route simple workloads to a budget tier such as GPT-6 Luna, which costs 1/20 as much as GPT-6 Sol per token, 2) Delete unused fine-tuned models (saves about $1,241/month per model), 3) Optimize prompt token usage through better prompt engineering (30-40% reduction), 4) Use batch processing for non-real-time workloads (50% discount on Global Standard token prices), and 5) Reserve Provisioned Throughput Units (PTU) for production workloads with consistent usage ($260 per PTU per month on Global, with a 15-PTU minimum of $3,900/month, for predictable capacity vs variable pay-as-you-go). Combined, these strategies reduced our Azure OpenAI spend from $4,200/month to $1,680/month (60% reduction).
